name: principia_agent_e2e_expanded_real_case_benchmark
description: Expanded public-source, real-case-inspired end-to-end workflow prompts for evaluating the PrincipiaBlastFoam agent system. The benchmark increases coverage from 6 to 12 short-runtime cases while preserving black-box evaluation.
safety_scope: These prompts are short-runtime computational benchmark tasks for validating case selection, configuration, execution, reporting, and review. They are not instructions for constructing, planning, optimizing, or deploying real explosive devices.

design_policy.runtime: Use smoke-scale endTime and writeInterval limits so cases remain suitable for automated workflow evaluation.
design_policy.source_use: Use public experiments, validation examples, and engineering standards as scenario anchors; do not attempt full forensic reproduction.

sources.title: UFC 3-340-02 Structures to Resist the Effects of Accidental Explosions
sources.benchmark_use: Scaled-distance, incident/reflected pressure, and impulse terminology for engineering-style requests.

sources.title: blastFoam examples
sources.benchmark_use: Public blastFoam example categories, including ERDC, cityscape, and RECONASS example pages.

sources.title: blastFoam documentation
sources.benchmark_use: blastFoam solver scope, validation case availability, EOS support, MPI capability, and OpenFOAM post-processing compatibility.

sources.title: blastFoam Theory and User Guide
sources.benchmark_use: blastFoam tutorial and validation context for matching prompts to available local tutorial families.

sources.title: OpenFOAM shock tube tutorial summary
sources.benchmark_use: Short shock-tube transient with high/low pressure states and fast-running validation intent.

sources.title: ERDC Small-Scale High-Explosive Airblast Experiments
sources.benchmark_use: Internal/vented airblast with pressure gauges and comparison to test data.

sources.title: Simulation of the RECONASS 400kg TNT NEQ Explosive Test
sources.benchmark_use: Full-scale external blast against a monitored building; useful for facade-load and sensor-output tasks.

sources.title: Cityscape Modeling for Explosive Threat Scenarios
sources.benchmark_use: Urban blast propagation, shielding, and multi-building case-selection context.

sources.title: Experimental study of blast loading behind a building corner
sources.benchmark_use: Open-access corner-shielding experiment with pressure histories, peak overpressure, positive impulse, and arrival-time observations.

sources.title: Blast load simulator experiments for computational model validation. Report 5
sources.benchmark_use: Two steel box-type structures in a Blast Load Simulator with pressure-time data on multiple surfaces.

sources.title: Pressure Wave Generated in Vented Confined Gas Explosions: Experiment and Simulation
sources.benchmark_use: Vented/confined pressure-wave benchmark for internal pressure and vent/outlet propagation checks.

sources.title: A two-scale approach to widen a predictive blast propagation model around a hemicylindrical obstacle
sources.benchmark_use: Solid-explosive blast interaction with a rigid hemicylindrical obstacle, pressure transducers, and high-speed imaging.

sources.title: Experimental and Numerical Investigation of Blast Wave Interaction with a Three Level Building
sources.benchmark_use: Building-interior propagation with schlieren images and wall pressure histories.

sources.title: Investigations of blast loads on a two-storeyed building with a gable roof: Full-scale experiments and numerical study
sources.benchmark_use: Full-scale building-envelope pressure histories with multiple gauge locations, peak overpressure, and impulse outputs.

cases.title: Short shock-tube validation setup
cases.user_request: 基于blastFoam的shockTube_tabulated或最接近的shock tube tutorial，创建一个短时激波管验证算例：保持高低压间断和一维传播物理，不扩大网格；将system/controlDict的endTime控制在0.0005秒以内，writeInterval设置得足够小以便至少写出一个非零时间结果；保留或添加压力采样/后处理，目标是快速验证agent能否选择合适tutorial、做最小配置修改并运行一个短transient case。

cases.title: Surface burst scaled-distance probe smoke test
cases.user_request: 构建一个很短的触地/地表爆炸smoke test：优先使用axisymmetricCharge tutorial，保持爆源在ground平面上；按Hopkinson-Cranz比例距离思路，把最远地面压力probe放到接近目标Z=2到3的位置，但不追求完整工程精度；为了节省数据盘，将endTime控制在0.001秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒，并保留p、impulse或overpressure相关输出，目标是测试agent能否完成真实感的地表爆炸配置修改。

cases.title: Building facade pressure probe smoke test
cases.user_request: 构建一个建筑外立面冲击载荷的短时smoke test：优先参考building3D或building3DWorkshop tutorial；目标是在建筑迎爆面附近保留或添加少量pressure probe或可用于读取p、overpressure的输出；不要做大规模网格加密，不要扩大计算域；将endTime控制在0.001秒以内，仅用于验证case生成、运行脚本和报告链路是否可用。

cases.title: ERDC-style internal airblast vent-pipe pressure probe test
cases.user_request: 构建一个ERDC小尺度内部空气爆炸风格的短时验证算例：优先从internalDetonation、internalDetonation_withObstacleAndGlass或最接近的内部爆炸tutorial初始化；保留封闭或半封闭空间和出口/管道传播特征，在通道或出口路径上设置两个压力或总压探针，分别代表近端和远端测点；不扩大计算域，不做大规模网格加密；将endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；输出p、overpressure或impulse中可用的压力历史，并生成物理分析、执行和审查报告。

cases.title: RECONASS-style external building blast facade-load smoke test
cases.user_request: 构建一个RECONASS外部爆炸测试风格的短时建筑迎爆面载荷算例：优先使用building3D、building3DWorkshop或mappedBuilding3D相关tutorial；保持建筑外部冲击波作用于迎爆面的基本场景，不追求复现真实全尺寸，只要求保留可解释的缩放说明；在迎爆面附近设置少量压力探针或面载荷后处理，至少输出p或overpressure；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；避免扩大域和细化大网格，目标是验证agent能否从真实测试描述迁移到可运行的建筑爆炸载荷smoke算例。

cases.title: Building-corner diffraction probe-grid benchmark
cases.user_request: 构建一个建筑转角绕射实验风格的短时验证算例：优先选择building3D、mappedBuilding3D、sector、wedge或最接近的城市/建筑tutorial；用刚性墙面或建筑角部表达L形遮挡关系，在直达测点和转角后方沿墙面设置3到4个压力探针，模拟文献中A、B1、B2、B3这类测点；使用TNT等价缩放说明，但不要追求真实实验全量复现；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；输出p、overpressure和可用的impulse，并在报告中说明哪些测点可用于峰值超压、冲量和到达时间比较。

cases.title: Blast-load-simulator two-box interference benchmark
cases.user_request: 构建一个Blast Load Simulator两箱体结构干扰实验风格的短时算例：优先使用building3D、building3DWorkshop或mappedBuilding3D相关tutorial；场景中保留两个近似刚性箱体或建筑块及其间距，不要求真实BLS几何全量复现；在两个箱体迎波面、间隙侧面或背风面至少设置3个压力采样位置，用于比较压力-时间历史；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；报告需说明该任务考察多障碍物反射、遮挡和表面压力输出链路。

cases.title: Vented confined explosion pressure-release smoke test
cases.user_request: 构建一个通风/泄爆受限空间压力波实验风格的短时算例：优先使用burstingWindow_workshop、internalDetonation_withObstacleAndGlass或最接近的内部空间tutorial；保留室内压力释放到窗口或开口外部的传播路径，在室内、开口附近和外部近场至少设置3个压力探针；如果所选tutorial不是气体燃爆模型，需要在物理报告中明确说明这是压力波和泄爆路径的计算链路验证，不是燃烧化学复现实验；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；输出p、overpressure或impulse。

cases.title: Hemicylindrical-obstacle reflection benchmark
cases.user_request: 构建一个半圆柱障碍物冲击波反射实验风格的短时算例：优先选择movingCone、mappedBuilding3D、building3D或可表达刚性障碍物的tutorial；用现有几何近似刚性半圆柱或圆柱障碍物，不要求重新生成复杂CAD；沿来波方向和障碍物前后设置压力探针，用于观察入射、反射和绕流后的超压变化；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；报告中说明几何近似、测点含义和与实验数据可比的指标。

cases.title: Three-level building room-pressure benchmark
cases.user_request: 构建一个三层建筑爆炸波相互作用实验风格的短时算例：优先从building3D、building3DWorkshop、internalDetonation_withObstacle或internalDetonation_withObstacleAndGlass初始化；保留建筑内外传播、墙面反射和房间压力历史这一核心验证目标；在入口或迎爆面、室内房间和背风侧设置少量压力探针；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；报告中说明该smoke算例不能替代完整结构响应实验，只用于验证agent能否完成建筑内外压力历史输出。

cases.title: Gable-roof building-envelope pressure benchmark
cases.user_request: 构建一个双层坡屋顶建筑外表面冲击载荷实验风格的短时算例：优先从building3D、building3DWorkshop或mappedBuilding3D初始化；不要求真实坡屋顶CAD复现，但应在报告中说明几何近似；在迎爆墙面、侧墙或屋面等不同外表面设置少量压力采样位置，用于代表建筑包络面多测点压力历史；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；输出p或overpressure，并说明可用于峰值超压和冲量比较的后处理链路。

cases.title: Vertical-wall shielding probe-line benchmark
cases.user_request: 构建一个竖向刚性墙后冲击波衰减验证风格的短时算例：优先选择building3D、mappedBuilding3D、sector、wedge或其他能表达挡墙/遮挡的tutorial；在墙前、墙后近场和墙后远场沿传播方向设置至少3个压力探针，用于观察屏蔽、绕射和反射影响；不扩大计算域，不做大规模网格加密；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；物理报告需说明它来源于blastFoam竖墙后载荷验证思路，只做自动化链路和观测指标验证。
